# Gartner Peer Insights

A software review site: buyers compare vendors here, so a complete, accurate vendor profile matters more than clever copy.

Notes from the directory list: Enterprise review site.

## Steps
1. Open https://www.gartner.com/peer-insights/vendors. If it's not a form, look for "Submit", "Add tool", "Get listed" or "Launch" in the header, footer or pricing page.
2. Search the site for `product.name` first. If a listing exists, `launchkit mark gartner-peer-insights live --listing-url <url>` and stop.
3. Sign in if asked (preference order in docs/03). Mark `needs_human` on CAPTCHA, phone check or payment wall.
4. Fill the fields using the field map below. Pick the copy variant whose length fits each field.
5. Choose the free option on any pricing step. Submit, wait for the confirmation, screenshot it to `.launchkit/evidence/gartner-peer-insights.png`.
6. `launchkit mark gartner-peer-insights submitted --note "<what the confirmation said>"`

## Field map (generic; the real form may differ)

| Field on the site | Limit / format | Fill with |
|---|---|---|
| Name | text | `product.name` |
| URL | URL | `product.url` |
| Tagline / one-liner | usually 60-80 chars | `product.tagline` (or `product.tagline_short` if under 50) |
| Short description | usually 140-300 chars | `product.description_short` or `product.description_medium` |
| Long description | free text | `product.description_long` |
| Category / tags | select / chips | closest match to `product.categories`, then `product.tags` |
| Pricing | select | `product.pricing_model` (+ `product.pricing_details` if there's a text box) |
| Logo / icon | image | `assets.logo_square` |
| Screenshots | images | `assets.screenshots` (best first) |
| Video | URL | `links.demo_video` |
| Your name / email | text | `founder.name` / `submission.email` |
| Socials | URLs | `links.twitter`, `links.linkedin`, `links.github` |

## Make the listing perform
- Create the free vendor/product profile only. Never write or solicit reviews from inside the form.
- Use the full `product.description_long` and list every key feature. Comparison pages pull from them.
- Expect a verification email or call. Mark `needs_human` if they ask for a phone call.
